1.why: All 14 screens are static card layouts with no pop-ups, animations, or moving images anywhere in the flow.

2.why: The current step pill is highlighted in dark blue, primary actions are solid blue buttons, and outcome messages appear in bold green, so key items clearly stand out.

3.why: Each screen contains a single task card with a heading, one labeled field, one primary button, and a top banner stating the next step, making the needed element immediately findable.

4.why: A 5-step progress tracker, per-step 'Next:' banners, and inline password rules externalize most steps, though the flow spans many stages and the new password must be recalled later at sign-in.

5.why: No 'remember me' checkbox, password manager prompt, or autofill option is visible on any sign-in or password screen.

6.why: Delivered codes are displayed in the on-page Logs panel for recognition and copying, and repeated layout elements (help card, step pills) remain familiar across screens.

7.why: Instructions are short plain sentences throughout, e.g. 'Enter your registered email address' and 'Select send, then use the practice code in Logs.'

8.why: No error state appears in any of the 14 screenshots, so whether error messages describe problems and fixes cannot be confirmed.

9.why: No concrete examples of what to type are shown; the password screen lists requirements (12+ characters, uppercase, number, symbol) without a sample, and input fields have no example placeholders.

10.why: The available choices—password entry and security codes—are clearly labeled with distinct buttons, though no face-login alternative exists in this system.

11.why: Every screen presents exactly one input and one primary action at a time, never multiple simultaneous choices.

12.why: Each action produces explicit feedback, e.g. 'A security code has been prepared', 'Password confirmed. Next, confirm your security code', and 'Privacy conditions accepted'.

13.why: A 'Help and safe sign-in reminders' panel appears on every screen alongside per-step guidance banners explaining what to do next.

14.why: The 'Send security code' button remains available for resending and a 'Forgot your password? Start recovery' link persists, but no mistake-and-retry sequence is actually demonstrated.

15.why: Header, navigation, step tracker, banner, card structure, help panel, and Logs section are identical across all 14 screens, providing a highly consistent learnable design.
